Software Maintenance & Support That Keeps You Running.

We keep your software secure, stable and up to date with proactive monitoring, regular updates, performance tuning and responsive technical support, so your systems keep pace with your business.

Let's Talk What we deliver
Overview

Software is never finished. Frameworks age, security vulnerabilities are discovered, data grows and business needs change. Without regular care, even good software becomes slow, fragile and risky. We look after your applications with proactive monitoring, regular updates, performance tuning and responsive support, whether we built them or not.

Why maintenance matters

Protect your technology investment

  • Security updates

    Regular patches for frameworks, libraries and servers to close known vulnerabilities.

  • Performance optimisation

    Ongoing tuning so your applications stay fast as data and usage grow.

  • Continuous improvement

    Small, steady enhancements that keep the software aligned with your business.

Is this right for you?

When this is a good fit

  • Nobody is looking after your software

    The original developers have moved on and issues are piling up.

  • Your application is slowing down

    Performance has dropped as data and users have grown.

  • Updates have been put off

    Frameworks and libraries are out of date and security is a concern.

  • You need a reliable support partner

    Your team needs someone to call when something goes wrong.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Do you support software you didn't build?

Yes. We start with a review of the code, infrastructure and documentation, then agree a support plan based on what we find.

What does a support plan include?

Typically monitoring, security updates, bug fixes, performance tuning and an agreed number of hours for improvements, tailored to your needs.

How quickly do you respond to issues?

Response times are agreed in your support plan according to the severity of the issue.

Can you modernise older applications?

Yes. We can upgrade frameworks and modernise parts of an application in stages, while keeping it running.

Need reliable support for your software?

Tell us about the systems you run today. We'll review their health and suggest a support plan that fits.
